plain_english_policy: Increase eligibility for federal welfare funds (TANF) to cover health and childcare benefits for low-income workers, not just the unemployed or non-working poor.

effects.rationale: Directly extends welfare benefits to a broader group (working poor) beyond traditional TANF eligibility.
Uses subsidies tied to federal funds, not employer mandates or public provision. The wording implies conditional support for families based on income.
Subsidies are targeted at low-income workers but do not explicitly redistribute wealth; they rely on existing welfare funds without progressive tax mechanisms.

evidence_quote: "extend health and child care subsidies to the working poor"
